title: garm-provider-docker provider config
description: The operator-set provider configuration for garm-provider-docker (ADR-005), written as TOML. This schema describes the same structure in JSON form for self-documentation (the v0.1.1 GetConfigJSONSchema command). This is the most-trusted trust tier (ADR-001): it strictly outranks pool extra_specs, which can never override docker_host, the privileged flag (derived from dind_mode only), a raw image reference, or a managed label. INTENTIONAL SCHEMA/LOADER DELTA: this schema is deliberately STRICTER than the runtime loader. Every nested object below sets "additionalProperties": false, so an unknown key inside [resources], [network], [flavors.<name>], [cache], or [extra_specs] fails schema validation (a lint/self-describe-time signal an operator's editor or CI can catch). The actual TOML loader (toml.DecodeFile, BurntSushi/toml's default lenient decode) IGNORES unknown keys at every level, top-level and nested alike, for forward compatibility — a config with a stray or newer-than-this-binary key still loads and runs. The two shipped example configs are additionally verified (internal/config/examples_test.go, via toml.MetaData.Undecoded()) to contain no unknown keys at all, so they never drift out of sync with either the schema or the loader's real struct fields.

then.description: dind_image is required, and must be non-empty, exactly when dind_mode is present and is not "none" — mirroring internal/config's validateDindMode. Two further loader rules are NOT expressible in draft-07 and are enforced in Go only: (1) runner_image, dind_image, and each flavor's runner_image must be pinned by a sha256 digest (name@sha256:<64-hex>) unless the corresponding allow_unpinned_*_image flag is set; (2) a pool's extra_specs may select a DinD mode within a widened ceiling even when the config's own dind_mode is "none" — in that case CreateInstance rejects the allocation before any Docker operation if dind_image is empty, a runtime condition no schema over this file alone can express. (A third rule this schema used to defer to Go-only enforcement — dind_mode must be a member of allowed_dind_modes, for EVERY dind_mode value including the absent/"none" default, not only the two non-"none" modes — IS now expressed below via the allOf conditionals, minItems on allowed_dind_modes, and draft-07's "contains"/"dependencies" keywords.)

dind_mode="privileged-sidecar" requires allowed_dind_modes to be present and to contain "privileged-sidecar" — mirroring the loader's fail-closed ceiling (allowed_dind_modes defaults to ["none"], the M4-W1 fail-closed amendment to ADR-001/ADR-005): a non-"none" dind_mode with an omitted, empty, or non-widened ceiling is REJECTED both here and by Config.EffectiveDindMode/validateDindMode at load/resolve time.
dind_mode="sysbox-runc" requires allowed_dind_modes to be present and to contain "sysbox-runc" — same fail-closed-ceiling rationale as the privileged-sidecar conditional above.

When dind_mode is absent or explicitly "none", the loader's membership check (validateDindMode: dind_mode must be a member of allowed_dind_modes, unconditionally — not only for the two non-"none" modes above) still applies. An explicitly-present allowed_dind_modes must therefore contain "none" too, or Load rejects the config exactly as it does for privileged-sidecar/sysbox-runc above. An OMITTED allowed_dind_modes is left alone here (the "dependencies" keyword only bites when the key is present): Load defaults it to ["none"], which trivially satisfies the loader's own check, so no schema constraint is needed for the omitted case.

docker_host.description: Address of the Docker daemon this provider manages allocations on. Defaults to unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Never overridable from extra_specs.

runner_image.description: Runner image reference, required (see the top-level "required"), digest-pinned (name@sha256:<64-hex>) unless allow_unpinned_runner_image is set. A named flavor may override it per pool; no extra_specs field accepts a raw image.

allow_unpinned_runner_image.description: Dev-only escape hatch: allow a tag-only runner_image. Never set in a real deployment.

dind_mode.description: Operator default DinD mode (ADR-001). Defaults to "none" (DinD off unless the operator opts in). A pool's extra_specs.dind_mode may select within allowed_dind_modes but never beyond it.

allowed_dind_modes.description: Operator ceiling (ADR-001 F7): the set of modes any pool's extra_specs may ever select. Defaults to ["none"] — FAIL-CLOSED: DinD is unavailable until the operator widens this list explicitly, so a pool can never obtain a privileged sidecar by omission. dind_mode must be a member (of EVERY mode, including "none" — see the allOf conditionals below), so widening this list is also what makes a non-"none" dind_mode loadable. An empty array is rejected by minItems here: the loader never accepts an empty ceiling regardless of dind_mode (Config.validateDindMode/EffectiveDindMode both fail closed on an empty AllowedDindModes).

dind_image.description: DinD sidecar image reference, digest-pinned like runner_image. Required when dind_mode != "none". Config-only; never varied by flavor or extra_specs.

allow_unpinned_dind_image.description: Dev-only escape hatch for dind_image, independent of allow_unpinned_runner_image.

storage_driver.description: Explicit --storage-driver for the DinD sidecar's dockerd (ADR-001). Defaults to overlay2; vfs is the slower, more compatible fallback. A pool may override within this enum via extra_specs.storage_driver.

resources.description: Container memory limits. No cpu or pids limits by design (ADR-005).

runner_memory.description: Runner memory ceiling as a human byte size (e.g. "8GiB"). Empty means unlimited. Bounds extra_specs.runner_memory.

dind_memory.description: DinD sidecar memory ceiling. Bounds extra_specs.dind_memory.

network.description: Per-job bridge network behavior (ADR-001). Config-only, never an extra_specs channel.

enable_job_network.description: Reserved; the isolated per-job network is always created. Defaults to true.

internal.description: Docker's internal flag on each per-job network. Defaults to false (2026-07-21 owner ruling): the runner needs egress to reach GitHub and DinD needs it for registry pulls. Job-to-job isolation comes from each allocation's own separate network, not this flag.

flavors.description: Named [flavors.<name>] entries. A flavor is selected per pool by name via extra_specs.flavor and is the ONLY channel that varies the runner image (ADR-002).

runner_image.description: Per-flavor runner image override, digest-pinned under the same rule as top-level runner_image.

extra_specs.description: Operator-owned controls over the GARM-admin extra_specs trust tier (ADR-005 H2). Governs what a pool's extra_specs may do beyond what the schema alone allows.

allowed_env.description: Allowlist of environment-variable NAMES a pool's extra_specs.extra_env may set on the runner container. Defaults to EMPTY (fail-closed: no extra env passes unless the operator opts a name in). Hard-reserved names (RUNNER_*, DOCKER_*, GARM_*, ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_*, JIT_CONFIG_ENABLED, GITHUB_URL, RUN_AS_ROOT, WAIT_FOR_DOCKER_SECONDS, BASH_ENV, ENV, IFS, PATH, LD_*, NODE_OPTIONS) are rejected even if listed here.
